Hello @lilitkarapetyan - are you sure that we don't need handlers for these events?

Are they being handled somewhere else?  If so, would it be wise to refer to the handler from this file?

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/7bc38128-e42c-437d-9eb9-7f89c3e5cb4c)
Yes, the handlers for these events are handled in a different part of the codebase.

issues.title: Missing handlers
issues.body:
When we run Serge, it warns that a number of handlers are missing:
![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/1108513/802b2421-01e6-42c3-ada9-b86b329c2167)

We should:
1. Check the necessary functionality is happening
2. Move the functionality to the handler block, so we can demonstrate handling it (and the error isn't reported)
